artboards.title: Print sheet, folds at the line

annotations.text:
Revelry Room tent cards. Each face is 4 x 6 in. The print sheet is 4 x 12 in, folded in half at the dashed line, so both faces read upright on the table.
The QR code links to instagram.com/mirage.seattle. Change the handle in the control above either card and it redraws. Print on heavy stock. The QR sits on cream so it scans in low light.
